crossRefs.note: Now Yahweh your God has given rest to your brothers, as he spoke to them. Therefore now return and go to your tents, to…
Only take diligent heed to do the commandment and the law which Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded you, to love…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: We will not return to our houses until the children of Israel have all received their inheritance.
translations.bsb: We will not return to our homes until every Israelite has taken possession of his inheritance.
translations.kjv: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
translations.asv: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
